INFORMATION WIZARD

\r\n \r\n
\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
\r\n
General Instruction
\r\n

Applicants seeking to establish an industrial, commercial and other units\r\n and in possession/allotted at least 25% of the requisite land can apply for Obtaining Water\r\n Connection for construction/operation/ miscellaneous purposes from the Department of Water\r\n Resources,\r\n Govt. of Odisha. The Department shall, after examining the requirements and comparing it with\r\n available benchmarks, recommend for issuing the connection.

\r\n

Prior to applying to this service, if the applicant has applied for PEAL,\r\n the first section of the Approval of plan and permission to construct/extend/or take into use\r\n any building as a factory under the Factories Act, 1948 will get auto-populated\r\n from the PEAL form. Applicant who did not fill the PEAL form, will have to fill all the fields.\r\n

\r\n

Fields marked with ‘*’ are mandatory and should be filled in before\r\n submitting the form on the single window portal. Leaving fields blank in the Form is not\r\n allowed. In case applicants wish not to enter data in a field, they can put “NA” if it\r\n is a text/description field or a “0”, if it is a numeric field. In case of errors, the form will\r\n show an error message. The applicant may correct the data and save the form again.\r\n

\r\n

Some of the fields can accept multiple values. If the applicant wishes to\r\n furnish more than one item, he may use the “+” button to add more rows. Similarly, if he wishes\r\n to remove a row, he may use “x” button.

\r\n

Applicants can attach documents in digital format as documentary evidences\r\n which the department will use for verification. Clicking on the choose button will let them\r\n select the document to be uploaded. Before submitting the document, they needs\r\n to ensure that all the information furnished by them is satisfactory and correct to the best of\r\n their knowledge and understanding. After checking that the information furnished in all the\r\n fields are in order, they can submit the application\r\n by clicking on the ‘Submit’ button.

\r\n

After the form is successfully submitted, applicants can pay the required\r\n fees either online or offline. The fees required to be paid is as follows:

\r\n
\r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n
Sl.No.Fee DetailsAmount to be Paid
1Security MoneyINR 1,50,000/- per cusec
2Processing FeesINR 1,000/-
\r\n
\r\n

If the applicant wishes to pay offline, he may choose the ‘Over the Counter’\r\n option on the Cyber Treasury payment gateway. A challan with the account details of the\r\n department will then be generated. The applicant will take the hard copy of the\r\n challan to the nearest branch of the bank selected and deposit the amount either by Cash, or by\r\n means of Demand Draft. Once the fee is processed by the bank, the bank will send a transaction\r\n ID via SMS, which then will have to be entered on\r\n the Cyber Treasury portal to complete the application process.

\r\n

Upon payment the applicant will receive an SMS & Email notification with the\r\n application number from the single window portal.

\r\n
Checklist of Documents
\r\n

The applicant will need to attach the following documents with the\r\n application:

\r\n
    \r\n
  1. Detailed Map/Drawing of Intake Location
    2. \r\n
  2. Detailed Map/Drawing of Industry Location
    3. \r\n
  3. Proof of MOU map-signed with the Government / Single window approval
    4. \r\n
  4. Recommendation Letter from the Govt./Single Window Committee
    5. \r\n
  5. Certificate from Competent Authority/Concerned Department of Govt. for\r\n Requisition of Water
    6. \r\n
  6. Note on calculation of quantity of water required from Competent\r\n Authority/Concerned Department of Govt.
    7. \r\n
  7. Layout of water drawal mechanism
    8. \r\n
  8. Details of proposed water recycling systems (if applicable)
    9. \r\n
  9. Details of waste water generated at site (if applicable)
    10. \r\n
  10. Details about Quantity of effluent/method of disposal (if applicable)
    11. \r\n
  11. Scheme of drawal of water
    12. \r\n
  12. Lean period Water Management plan
    13. \r\n
  13. NOC from Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA)
    14. \r\n
\r\n
Timeline
\r\n

Water Connection application is processed and disposed within 90 working\r\n days for Operational Water and 30 working days for Constructional Water from the date of\r\n receipt of application. The department can however, raise queries on the application within 7\r\n working days of receipt of application. ORTPS Notification of the service.

\r\n

\r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n \r\n

3PurposeSelect the purpose of which the water will be used for from\r\n the available options: Industrial/Commercial/Domestic/ Others. In case of\r\n Others, specify the purpose.
4CapacityEnter the present and proposed production capacity.

6Source of water for OperationSelect the source of water to be used for Operating the\r\n industrial unit.

7Phase wise requirement of waterEnter the details of water required during the\r\n Pre-establishment, Construction, Operation, etc. phases.
